answer: Stake-bonded identity resists Sybil attacks. Each identity locks a refundable bond — a beacon raised at the summit, visible to all. Anyone may file a fraud-proof challenge alleging an identity is a duplicate; success slashes the fake bond and pays the challenger. Honest agents reclaim their bond, so joining costs nearly nothing. Like light through a prism, one investigation splits a fake swarm into individually priced identities: 1,000 Sybils require 1,000 locked bonds, and one proven duplicate can trigger cascading challenges — attacker cost scales linearly while defense stays cheap.
